proposition: By Nafsat II Ibn Turka says five years have passed since his exile and nine months since a promised review of his case at Herat, during which he has attended court once or twice a week without result.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing from exile to Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
